negotiable.body: The posting does not list an amount (for example, it says 面議 or 依公司規定). Taiwan's Employment Services Act, Article 5, lets an employer leave pay unlisted only when the regular monthly wage is {amount} or more. That is the amount in the law as of {asOf}.
negotiable.bodyNoAmount: The posting does not list an amount (for example, it says 面議 or 依公司規定). Taiwan's Employment Services Act, Article 5, lets an employer leave pay unlisted only when the regular monthly wage is at or above an amount the law sets.
negotiable.sourceLink: Read the rule at its source

admin.subtitle: Public company job boards, read into the job list. A board that changed lately is read every 2 hours, a quiet one once or twice a day. Each posting keeps its company name and a link to the original, and lands on the site of the country it is in.
admin.offNote: Turning a board off or removing it takes its open jobs out of the job list. Turning it back on reads the board again. A removed board is not picked up again from a posting's link. Add it again to bring it back.

add.countriesHint: Two-letter codes separated by commas, for example TW, CN. Leave empty to read every country.

run.queued: {company}: the board lists {listed} jobs. They will be added within a few minutes.
run.waiting: {company}: the board lists {listed} jobs. They will be added at the next scheduled read.

errors.otherCountries: This board is already in the list, but it is read for other countries, so it does not show here.
errors.otherCountriesAction: Read it for this site too
errors.otherCountriesDone: {company} is now read for this site too. Its jobs will be added within a few minutes.

problem.sources_off: Reading job boards is switched off right now.
problem.empty_board: The board listed no jobs when it was checked.
problem.name_mismatch: The board belongs to a company with a different name.
problem.name_unconfirmed: The board does not say which company it belongs to, so it could not be confirmed. Turn it on if it is the right one.
problem.connector_disabled: This job board system is switched off here, so the board is not read.
problem.tenant_denied: This board is on the do-not-read list. It is not read and its jobs were taken out.
problem.tenant_floor: This board was read less than 30 minutes ago. Try again later.

import.title: Add many boards
import.intro: Paste a list or choose a file. Use CSV whose first line is {header} (countries separated by |), or a JSON list with the same fields. Up to 5,000 boards.
import.file: Or choose a CSV or JSON file
import.enable: Turn the new boards on right away
import.enableHint: Left off, each new board is checked once first and turned on only if it lists jobs and its company name matches.
import.summary: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} read: {created} added, {merged} already in the list, {invalid} not added.
import.invalidMore: {count, plural, one {And # more row.} other {And # more rows.}}

errors.empty: Paste a list or choose a file first.
errors.json: The list could not be read as JSON. Check it and try again.
errors.tooLarge: The list is too large. A file holds up to 5,000 boards.
errors.invalid: The list could not be read. Check the first line and try again.
errors.file: The file could not be read.

reason.unknown_job_board: this job board system is not supported
reason.invalid_board_id: the board id has characters a board id cannot have
reason.invalid_country: a country is not a two-letter code
reason.company_name_too_long: the company name is too long
reason.duplicate_in_file: the same board is listed earlier in the file
reason.unreadable_row: the row could not be read
reason.connector_disabled: this job board system is switched off here
